About this snapshot

Figures are dated and incomplete. Funding is a floor over included closed rounds, including labelled grants; reported cumulative totals are separate, and overlapping financings are not added twice. Source excerpts and uncertainty accompany the claims. Clinical trials cover the cited ClinicalTrials.gov records only. Map boundaries follow Natural Earth and imply no position on territorial status.
